## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe one concrete trigger and what this change makes happen.

## Validation

List checks actually run, environment and results. Keep source/browser/simulator/device evidence distinct; name failures, skips and remaining limits.

## Review points

Describe any effect on target identity, confirmation, uncertainty/recovery, dependencies, upstream notices or native IDs. For images, use synthetic data and update provenance. Remove private paths, pairing material, owner content and internal discussion before submitting.
